Shadowhide gnolls fill the valley; Lieutenant Fangore (26, well above you) leads them at its north end: clear his escort first and fight him at full health. Stay out of Stonewatch Keep to the south: its orcs are elite. Careful: Two gnoll guards stay with him and join the fight whenever he is attacked, even if he has wandered a short way off; other gnolls stand close by and wander through the area.
